title: EC_GROUP_cmp crashes for groups without generators
claim: Comparing two equal EC_GROUP objects created with curve parameters but no generator dereferences a NULL EC_POINT instead of returning a result or error.
notes: The issue was open, unassigned, labeled help wanted and triaged: bug, with no linked PR when checked on 2026-11-05.
The issue cites a752594 as the affected version, but the OpenSSL GitHub commit API reports no commit for that SHA; this case tests the pinned current master revision instead.
The project-local patch is a candidate behavior fix, not an upstream-submitted change.
